data.name: Becky Blackbell
data.description:
Becky is a very kind child, but with her being the daughter of a major military manufacturer, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to be mature, initially attempting to take Anya under her wing when she sees her as a brat. She does not attempt to get close to Damian Desmond despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend Damian and even Anya, who was bullied by Damian's group during their orientation. However, Anya's smug smile and defiance toward Damian later won over Becky's admiration and respect.

Despite the difference in social status, Becky really genuinely cares about her friend and supports her, although some of Anya's words seem absurd or incomprehensible to her. Becky cares what Anya think of her own actions. The girl was also embarrassed and touched when she received a keychain from Anya as a gift, and began to wear her own as a sign of their friendship, although this is just a cheap trinket compared to the more expensive gifts that Becky is accustomed to receive.

Becky is also quite patient, going along with Anya's desire to be called "Starlight Anya" after her success at getting a Stella Star, even though she quickly got annoyed by it. She is also a caring and protective girl as seen when she often confronts Damian whenever he bullies Anya, even saying that she will protect her no matter what.

Becky has proven to be fairly intelligent and academically gifted, ranking 42nd on her exam out of over 200 students, thus meeting standards overall. She also strives to be an idealized version of an adult by engaging in such hobbies as watching adult romance TV programs. However, this has made it difficult for her to associate with her peers, making her friendless for a while.

Becky is also seen to have a somewhat low outlook on monetary value as seen when she shows little interest in mentioning how she gained presents such as a diamond embedded doll, and her own small house in her yard for doing well in school. At the same time, she is well aware of how rich she is. Her wealth often gives her what she wants, and periodically she willingly uses it to get what she desires. Becky is also capable of casually offending persons by showing her surprise at their lower income, although she does not do this intentionally. She periodically demonstrates this trait with Anya. For example, Becky is not impressed with her friend's cash that her father gave her for a shopping trip. Also, when Becky visits Anya one day, she constantly compared her friend's house with her larger home, which eventually prompted Anya to quickly finish the tour, to Becky's bewilderment.

Becky is a romantic girl, being a big fan of romance movies and television shows like Berlint in Love, which she enjoys watching in her free time. She even thinks that Anya's efforts to get along with Damian is because Anya has a crush on him and tries to help her win his heart. Becky also teases Damian, aware of his feelings for Anya, and while she does not like him, she enjoys the perceived romance between him and her friend, believing that seeing their drama is better than her TV romances.

Becky can be mean, though she rarely shows this side of herself. Whenever arguing with Damian and his friends, she throws back just as nasty insults when they insult her and Anya. When George Glooman arrived at school the day after he claimed that he would have to leave Eden due to his family company's apparent bankruptcy, Becky coldly told George to return the gifts their classmates gave to him, which she later brought up as leverage to get a macaron from him.

Before meeting Anya, she used to act cocky and often engaged in brawls with other kids teasing them for their lower social position, having no friends at all. The only bond she has besides her father is with her butler Martha Marriott, who acts as a mother figure for Becky. Thanks to her friendship with Anya, Becky has shown to have changed her behavior toward others. Proof of this is when she invites Anya to go shopping together in order to make Anya get closer to Damian. While initially putting all her effort into helping Anya, Becky later focuses on buying dresses for herself to impress Anya's dad Loid. After seeing Anya get exhausted from shopping, Becky nervously asks if she disliked their outing, but Anya answers that she had so much fun, something that makes Becky feel genuinely happy. The girls then each get a sheep keychain as a memento of their trip, and eventually forget the reason they went to buy clothes in the first place. Martha later points out that Anya is the first person Becky truly cares for.
